resources.string: Health Connect is missing or outdated \u2014 tap to install or update
Health Connect needs permissions \u2014 tap to grant

This app reads your weight, body fat, bone mass, lean body mass, body water, basal metabolic rate and height measurements from Health Connect on this device, combines measurements taken at the same time into one weigh-in, and uploads those weigh-ins to your Garmin Connect account.

The app only reads data — it never adds, changes or deletes anything in Health Connect.

Nothing is sent anywhere except Garmin Connect. No measurement values are stored by the app — only record identifiers, so the same weigh-in is never uploaded twice.
Sign in to Garmin to upload measurements automatically
All measurements are already in Garmin Connect — nothing to upload

Upload failed, will retry with next sync
Weigh-ins are not reaching Garmin Connect. Tap to sign in again.
The app can no longer read your measurements. Tap to grant access again.
Measurements refused by Garmin Connect (not retried): %1$d
Uploads to Garmin Connect have failed for over a day. Tap to check.
Android may pause this app and remove its permissions if you do not open it. Tap and turn off “Pause app activity if unused”.
Battery optimization lets Android hold back the sync for hours. Tap, open Battery and choose Unrestricted.
Blood pressure: Health Connect readings have no pulse, so each one is sent with your Garmin watch\'s heart rate at that minute. Readings wait until the watch has synced.
Tap to allow blood pressure access.
Readings dropped after a day without Garmin watch heart rate to use as the pulse: %1$d

Water: new Health Connect entries are added to Garmin\'s daily hydration from the moment access is granted (older ones are not, Garmin cannot tell if they are already counted). Deleting or editing an entry corrects Garmin.
